self-centred.formation: self（自己） + centre（中心；英式拼写） + -ed（构成形容词，表示处于/具有某状态）

englishDefinitions: an exaggerated opinion of one's own qualities or abilities : vanity
self-conceit.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *kap- to grasp；抓住、掌握

englishDefinitions: freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities
self-confidence.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin fidere-to trust；信任 + -ence（动作、状态或性质名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: having confidence in yourself and your abilities
self-confident.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、考研、GMAT、SAT、雅思
self-confident.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin fidere-to trust；信任

self-conscious.definitionCn: adj. 不自在的，难为情的；刻意的，做作的；自觉的，有自我意识的（较正式，哲学、心理学用语）
englishDefinitions: aware of yourself as an individual or of your own being and actions and thoughts- D.M.Potter；excessively and uncomfortably conscious of your appearance or behavior

self-conscious.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin scire-"to know."；知道

self-contained.definitionCn: adj. （人或事物）独立的，自足的，自成体系的；（住所、套房等）设备齐全的，独门独户的；（人）沉默寡言的，含蓄内敛的，自持的
englishDefinitions: constituting a complete and independent unit in and of itself；in full control of your faculties
self-contained.formation: con-（共同、一起；加强语气） + Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin tenere-to hold；握住、持有 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

self-control.definitionCn: n. 自我控制，自制力，克己
englishDefinitions: the act of denying yourself; controlling your impulses；the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior
self-control.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、SAT、雅思
self-control.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin contra "against"；再次 + Latin rota "wheel"；轮子

englishDefinitions: the skill of being able to protect yourself from physical attack without using weapons
self-defence.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin de "down, down from, from, off; concerning"；向下、离开；关于 + PIE root *gwhend- "to strike, kill"；击打 + -ence（动作、状态或性质名词后缀）

self-deprecation.definitionCn: n. 自嘲；自我贬低；过分谦虚
englishDefinitions: the fact of deliberately making your own achievements or abilities seem unimportant
self-deprecation.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin de "down, down from, from, off; concerning"；向下、离开；关于 + *prek- to ask, entreat；询问 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act of killing yourself；the act of destroying yourself
self-destruction.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + destructio；来源形式；原文未给出可确认的独立词根义 + destruction；来源形式；原文未给出可确认的独立词根义 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: personal independence
self-direction.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + directio；来源形式；原文未给出可确认的独立词根义 + direction；来源形式；原文未给出可确认的独立词根义 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

self-discipline.definitionCn: n. 自律；自我修养；自我训练
englishDefinitions: the ability to make yourself do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant
self-discipline.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin dis- "apart, asunder, in a different direction, between,"；分开、相反或朝不同方向 + PIE root *kap- to grasp；抓住、掌握

self-discovery.definitionCn: n. 自我发现，自我探索
englishDefinitions: discovering your own individuality

self-drive.level: 中考、四级、六级、考研、雅思
self-drive.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *dhreibh- "to drive, push"；驱动 + -ive（具有或倾向于某种性质的形容词后缀）

self-driving.definitionCn: adj. （用于车辆）自动驾驶的；无人驾驶的；（用于旅行、租车等）自驾的；自己驾驶的
self-driving.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、考研、雅思
self-driving.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *dhreibh- "to drive, push"；驱动 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀） + -ive（具有或倾向于某种性质的形容词后缀）

self-educated.definitionCn: adj. 自学的，自修的，自我教育的
englishDefinitions: educated by your own efforts rather than by formal instruction
self-educated.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + PIE root *deuk- "to lead"；引导、带领 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: withdrawing into the background; making yourself inconspicuous
self-effacement.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin facies-"appearance, form, figure," and secondarily "visage, countenance,"；外观 + -ment（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

self-effacing.definitionCn: adj. 谦让的；谦逊的；不出风头的
englishDefinitions: not wanting to attract attention to yourself or your abilities
self-effacing.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + Latin facies-"appearance, form, figure," and secondarily "visage, countenance,"；外观 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

self-employed.definitionCn:

n. the self-employed：个体经营者，自雇者

self-employed.level: 高考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、SAT、雅思
self-employed.formation: em-（使进入、使成为） + Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *pel- (2)-to fold；折叠 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

self-employment.definitionCn:
个体经营
自营管理
[劳经] 自谋职业
自我雇佣
self-employment.formation: em-（使进入、使成为） + Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *pel- (2)-to fold；折叠 + -ment（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a feeling of pride in yourself

self-evident.definitionCn: adj. 显而易见的，不言而喻的
englishDefinitions: evident without proof or argument
self-evident.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + ex-"out, out of, fully"；向外、离开、以前的 + Latin videre-"to see, notice, observe"；看见、注意、观察

englishDefinitions: in a self-evident manner
self-evidently.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + ex-"out, out of, fully"；向外、离开、以前的 + Latin videre-"to see, notice, observe"；看见、注意、观察 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

self-explanatory.definitionCn: adj. 自明的；不需加以说明的
englishDefinitions: easy to understand and not needing any more explanation
self-explanatory.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + PIE root *pele- (2) "flat; to spread"；平坦；铺开

englishDefinitions: the expression of your thoughts or feelings, especially through activities such as writing, painting, dancing, etc.
self-expression.level: 中考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、GMAT、SAT、雅思

self-feeding.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *pa- to feed, protect；保护 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀） + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

self-funded.definitionCn:
自筹资金的
自费的

self-funded.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + *bhudh- bottom, base；底部、基础 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

self-governing.definitionCn: adj. 自治的；自己管理自己的

self-image.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、SAT、雅思
self-image.formation: im-（不、非；进入） + Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *aim- "to copy"；模仿、复制

self-interest.definitionCn: n. 私利，自身利益；（常含贬义）利己主义，自私自利；（经济学）自利，自利原则

self-interest.level: 高考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、GMAT、SAT、雅思
self-interest.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin terra "earth"；土地、地球 + -est（最高级后缀）

self-interested.definitionCn: adj. 自私的；利己主义的

self-knowledge.definitionCn: n. 自知之明，自我认识

self-knowledge.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *gno- "to know"；知道、认识

self-observation.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + ob- toward; against; before; near; across; down,；朝向、对着；在前、附近、横过或向下 + PIE root *ser- (1)-to protect；保护 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

self-perception.definitionCn: n. 自我知觉，自我认知（个人对自身的感知和认识）；（心理学）个体通过观察自身行为来认识和推断自身内在心理状态（如态度、情绪）的过程

self-portrait.definitionCn: n. 自画像（本人绘制的或拍摄的自己的肖像）；自我写照，自我描述

self-preservation.definitionCn: n. 自我保护，自我保存，自卫本能

self-proclaimed.definitionCn: adj. 自称的，自封的（常含怀疑或讽刺意味）

self-propelled.definitionCn: adj. （车辆、机械等）自我推进的，机动式的，自带动力、可自行移动的；（过程、行为等）自我驱动的，指依靠自身惯性或内在力量持续发展的

self-regulate.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *reg- "move in a straight line," with derivatives meaning "to direct in a straight line," thus "to lead, rule."；直行；引导、统治

self-regulation.definitionCn: n. 自我调节，自动调节；活动参与者或相关组织而非政府等外部机构所进行的自律，自我监管；（心理学）个体对自身情绪、注意力、冲动、思维及行为的自我调控
self-regulation.level: 高考、四级、六级、考研、SAT、雅思
self-regulation.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *reg- "move in a straight line," with derivatives meaning "to direct in a straight line," thus "to lead, rule."；直行；引导、统治 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

self-regulatory.definitionCn: adj. 自律的，自我管理的，自我监管的；自动调节的（等于 self-regulative）

self-reliance.definitionCn: n. 自力更生，依靠自己；自恃

self-reliant.definitionCn: adj. 自力更生的，自立的，不依赖他人的
englishDefinitions: (of persons) free from external control and constraint in e.g. action and judgment

self-repair.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin parare "make ready, prepare"；准备

self-reported.definitionCn: adj. 自我报告的，自述的（指数据、症状等由当事人本人报告或陈述，而非经外部核实）

englishDefinitions: acting with less concern for yourself than for the success of the joint activity

self-satirizing.definitionCn: adj．自嘲的：指对自己进行讽刺、嘲笑的行为或态度。

englishDefinitions: the fact of being too pleased with yourself or your own achievements
self-satisfaction.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *sa- "to satisfy."；使满足 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

self-service.definitionCn:

n. 自助服务

self-service.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、GMAT、雅思
self-service.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin servus-slave；奴隶

self-serving.definitionCn: adj. 自私自利的，自私的
englishDefinitions: interested only in gaining an advantage for yourself
self-serving.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin servus-slave；奴隶 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

self-study.definitionCn: n. 自学（多作不可数名词，指在没有教师指导的情况下自己独立进行的学习）

self-sufficiency.definitionCn: n. 自给自足；自立，独立自主

self-sufficient.definitionCn: adj. 自给自足的；极为自负的；过于自信的
englishDefinitions: able to do or produce everything that you need without the help of other people
self-sufficient.level: 高考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、GMAT、SAT、雅思
self-sufficient.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + Latin preposition sub "under, below, beneath, at the foot of," also "close to, up to, towards;" of time, "within, during;" figuratively "subject to, in the power of;" also "a little, somewhat"；在下方 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放

self-understanding.definitionCn: n. 自我理解；自知之明
self-understanding.formation: under-（在下、不足、未充分） + Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE *ndher- under；下方、在下面 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

self-worth.definitionCn: n. 自我价值，自我价值感，自尊
englishDefinitions: the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
self-worth.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、考研、GRE、SAT、雅思
self-worth.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + PIE root *wer- (2) "to turn, bend."；转动、弯曲

self-written.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + *writan-tear, scratch；撕裂、刮擦 + 不规则动词词形

selfie.formation: self（自己；古英语 self） + -ie（口语/昵称式名词后缀）

selfish.definitionCn: adj. 自私的；利己主义的

selfish.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + -ish（形容词后缀，表示“有……特征的/略带……”）

selfishly.level: 中考、高考、四级、六级、考研、GMAT、SAT、雅思
selfishly.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + -ly（方式、程度或状态副词后缀；也可构成形容词）

selfishness.definitionCn: n. 自私自利，自我中心，利己主义
englishDefinitions: stinginess resulting from a concern for your own welfare and a disregard of others
selfishness.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

selfless.level: 中考、高考、六级、考研、GRE、GMAT、SAT、雅思

englishDefinitions: the quality of unselfish concern for the welfare of others；acting with less concern for yourself than for the success of the joint activity
selflessness.formation: Proto-Germanic *selbaz-"self,"；自身、自己 + -less（缺少…的后缀） + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

sell.definitionCn:

vi. 卖；出售；受欢迎；有销路

sell-by.definitionCn:

seller.definitionCn:
n. 卖方，售货员
n. (Seller)人名；(匈)谢勒；(西)塞列尔

selling.definitionCn:

un.definitionCn: pron. 家伙，东西（one 的另一种拼写）
englishDefinitions: An inseparable verbal prefix or particle. It is prefixed: (a) To verbs to express the contrary, and not the simple negative, of the action of the verb to which it is prefixed; as in un bend, un coil, un do, un fold. (b) To nouns to form verbs expressing privation of the thing, quality, or state expressed by the noun, or separation from it; as in un child, un sex. Sometimes particles and participial adjectives formed with this prefix coincide in form with compounds of the negative prefix un- (see 2d Un- ); as in un done (from un do), meaning unfastened, ruined; and un done (from 2d un- and done ) meaning not done, not finished. Un- is sometimes used with an intensive force merely; as in un loose.
un.formation: Old English un；来源形式；原文未给出可确认的独立词根义
